Not published.** Bella Lee · Council · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Evidence base is the authorized 2026 campaign site (home, about, /policy living document lastmod 1 Jul 2026), the 30 Mar 2026 launch coverage, the 30 Jun 2026 joint-candidate coverage, and a VoteMate Victoria check (no Lee profile, no questionnaire). Challenger: no 2022–26 City term, so no Record lines and no incumbent haircut. 2026 plan taken at face value. ## Card

### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **—** "Lower the cost of living" / "Life in our City is too expensive" is not a residential-rate cap, formula, year-path or override rule. — —
Downtown order M26 / M27 **—** No Public Order Team and no bylaw-hours position. "Police officers are not mental health workers" is diagnosis. A theft special unit is not M26. — —
Housing M6 **said** "Encourage the building of 3 & 4 bedroom units, so families have space to live." Family mix named. No unit target and no 25/20/15 shares. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
Household bill M66d **—** Water, sewer, stormwater and the combined household number are not mentioned. — —
Written program — **yes** Authorized /policy living document with eight named sections and bullets (Cost of Living, Housing, Healthcare, Public Safety, Homelessness, Arts & Recreation, Climate Change & Transportation, Thriving Communities). Written and current. Not costed. No tax formula, no unit target, no implementation calendar. Home and about are biography plus past campaigns. Lee is not on VoteMate Victoria as of this retrieve. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. A dash is unknown, not a fail. Rules as written on . ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Close 2.0** "Homes for families and not investors. Encourage the building of 3 & 4 bedroom units, so families have space to live." · Commits × Comparable: family mix named, not the 25/20/15 shares, and no unit count. Context, same page, not scored separately: "Let’s build more housing, affordable housing, and protect renters." and the Cost of Living bullet "Build affordable housing." [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
2 M6b land bank + co-ops **Close 2.0** "More purpose built co-ops and below market housing. Including making it easier to form a housing co-op." · Commits × Comparable: co-ops named, no City land bank, no 99-year lease, no acquisition fund. Context, same housing block, not scored separately: "Use empty lots, or buildings being left to rot until they can only be demolished, and turn them into affordable housing." and "Implement a land value capture tax to discourage further housing speculation." [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time position, no published standard, nothing on AI pre-screening. /policy, home and about checked. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs do not appear. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC position, no suite amnesty. Land-value-capture is scored as context on row 2, not as M8. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No position on unified command, co-location, or a downtown operations desk. "Establish a Special Unit to respond to theft from local businesses" is a theft unit, not a Public Order Team. Diagnosis on police and mental health is not M26. — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response — "Police officers are not mental health workers." raises the wrong-responder problem with no CRCL, IMCRT, VICOT, or dispatch instrument. Mentions, so a dash in every column. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. The 7 a.m. tent-removal sentence is scored as Mentions on row 10, not here. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — "Establish a Special Unit to respond to theft from local businesses" names a unit, not data-targeted enforcement of chronic disorder. Not M28's goal. Face-test: a theft unit is not scored as data-targeting. Left as a dash, not Partial. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — "Public parks and green spaces should not be the only answer for someone’s shelter, and the enforcement of 7 a.m. tent removal bylaws costs taxpayers a small fortune just to impound and destroy people’s belongings." raises daytime sheltering without a commit to keep, repeal or replace the bylaw. Mentions, so a dash. Not Opposed. Face-test: she describes the cost; she does not say she will stop the 7 a.m. rule. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — "Support harm reduction, and safe supply" is not a child-focused buffer, a bylaw/DPOT list, or a VicPD/CDSA position. Not Opposed. The 30 Mar launch line on an "opioid epidemic" is diagnosis, not this instrument. No buffer sentence on /policy, home or about. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — Parks-as-shelter diagnosis sits on row 10 as Mentions. No named-space reclaiming plan, no encampment-removal rule, no night lighting. Treatment beds are context on row 23, not a reclaiming instrument. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) — "Life in our City is too expensive" / "I will be a councillor that will fight to lower your cost of living every day" raises affordability without a rate, cap, formula or year-path. Mentions, so a dash. Land-value-capture is a housing-speculation instrument, already context on row 2, not a residential-rate rule. — —
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund, no debt rule, no supermajority override. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — The combined household number, water, sewer and stormwater do not appear. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — Homepage/about "Fought for our partners in the CRD to take on their share of costs for the homelessness crisis" is past advocacy, not a 2026 municipal promise. Background is not a source. No 2026 ledger, refusal threshold or published transfer table. "Victoria is not shouldering all the costs of policing in the CRD" is the regional-police sentence, scored on row 33. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — The filtration plant and regional water rates do not appear. A CRD Rec pass and an outdoor regional pool are recreation, scored or parked on row 39, not Goldstream. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office **Close 2.0** "Vacancy Tax for empty storefronts Downtown, and other hubs in the city." · Commits × Comparable: a commercial-vacancy instrument (M71 uses an 11%→5% vacancy target; she names a tax). No Strategic Economic Plan, no "one mandate not a new office." Context, same Thriving Communities block, not scored separately: partial-hours business registry and off-hour sublets. DVBA graffiti/facade is a different sentence, scored on row 26. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no first-hour, no capital-approval threshold, no permit-fee schedule. Y1 parking is the 15-min grace; it is not on this platform. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — The closing acknowledgement of Lək̓ʷəŋən / Songhees and Esquimalt homelands is not M1–M5. No standing government-to-government table, no procurement target, no place-name programme, no cultural-protocol package, no urban Indigenous liaison. A dash is allowed. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Close 2.0** "If a landlord refuses to make a repair, the City will do it and send them the bill with a 25% service tax. Allow pets in rentals in Victoria." · Commits × Comparable: renter-protection instruments named. Not demoviction, not STR licensing, not an indoor-heat standard. M9c struck — vacancy-control-between-tenancies is not scored. Ambiguity up from Partial: the cluster’s tenant-protection half is the match. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — No rules-based digital allocation design, no waitlist instrument. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput **Close 2.0** "Create a housing liaison to help folks get out of transitional housing." · Commits × Comparable: STEP-like throughput out of transitional housing, not Housing First −50% unsheltered and not STEP named. No quarterly count. Context, same homelessness block, not scored separately: "Work with the Province to create more treatment beds." The 7 a.m. tent-removal paragraph remains Mentions on row 10. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) **Close 2.0** "Build purpose-built housing for doctors and nurse practitioners in return for a practice in Victoria. Create a city owned walk in clinic." · Commits × Comparable: Colwood-style clinic and tied housing, no childcare-spaces target, no 18–25 programme. Professional background at MCFD is not a source. Context, Cost of Living, not scored separately and not M13d: "Support local farmers and expand good food boxes." M13 school food is \$0 and sits on M13d, not here. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools and SD61 do not appear. Good-food-boxes are not a standing school-food agreement. Crystal Pool recreation is not M13d. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm **Close 2.0** "Continue to fund the Downtown Victoria Business Association to support local businesses with graffiti removal and facade repairs." · Commits × Comparable: graffiti/facade delivery via DVBA, not the City 90% graffiti standard, pest programme or sanitation hours. Distinct sentence from the vacancy-tax row. Context, not scored separately: "Garbage and recycling being picked up on time" is Mentions of sanitation. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) **Close 2.0** "Bike lane improvements and connecting bike lanes to other municipalities." · Commits × Comparable: network completion, not Vision Zero audit, not M38 calming inventory, no named corridor. M39 30 km/h is struck. Thriving-Communities cycling clause is the same topic, not a second mark. Capital Bikes board service is professional background, not a source. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls **Close 2.0** "Expand Fare Free transit to seniors. Build more bus shelters. Advocate for lower bus fees." · Commits × Comparable: City-side shelters and fare advocacy, not a City-operated transit service and not a sidewalk-gap standard. Distinct bullets from the bike-lane row. Cost of Living "Expand free transit for youth to include seniors" is the same fare-free claim, not a second mark. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — No accessibility audit, no public-washroom count or hours standard. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — "Ensuring road construction makes sense" raises construction without a maintenance backlog, pothole standard or sequencing rule. Mentions, so a dash. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — A theft special unit is not cost-spreading of private security. No camera-registry or cost-share instrument. Past Police Board service is background, not a source. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — Community paramedicine is not named. The police/mental-health diagnosis is already a dash on row 7. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) **Close 2.0** "Demand a Regional Police Force." · Commits × Comparable, not Same. 1 Sep pack: M29b is convene-and-publish; no binding other force. Demanding a regional force is the regionalisation goal with a harder instrument than the pack now allows. Not Aligned. FLAG vs any 1 Sep D14 Aligned 3.0. Context: "We need to reimagine our regional public safety plan so that Victoria is not shouldering all the costs of policing in the CRD." Bail-reform advocacy is provincial and is not scored. [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target — No safety dashboard, no published enforcement record, no crime-reduction number. The theft special unit is not a KPI set. — —
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues — Heritage standards, street furniture and cultural venues do not appear. "Build on the Rock Bay revitalization plan" is not a heritage-standards or venue instrument and is not mapped to M45c by adjacency. — —
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — No pedestrian-priority zone, no signature-project shortlist, no referendum. Bike lanes are scored on row 27. Rock Bay revitalization is not clearly M45c; face-test fails, so a dash. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks **Close 2.0** "Build infrastructure in our parks like BBQ's and pavilions for when it rains." · Commits × Comparable: parks programme (M49 elevate parks), not heritage incentives or ornamental lighting, not M47 waterfront walkways. Same bullet, not scored separately: "Allow for beer on beaches." Context, Thriving Communities, not a second mark: "Allow local business in select parks (coffee, hot dog stands, ice cream)." [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor **Close 2.0** "Create a CRD Rec pass, so you can access any recreation center in Greater Victoria." · Commits × Comparable: recreation-access instrument, not a culture/sport/arts funding floor and not M50 extended hours. Legal-feasibility FLAG: a CRD-wide pass is not a unilateral City instrument; face-test still scores the published sentence. Context, same Arts & Recreation block, not scored separately: "Lower recreation fees especially while Crystal Pool is under construction"; "Continue to invest in the arts in our city" (Mentions of arts, no floor); "Make hosting a festival easier"; "Work with our CRD partners for an outdoor regional pool." [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — Competitive testing of City services does not appear. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews — No zero-based cycle, no grant test, no three-part test. Cost-of-living language is Mentions on row 13. — —
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard — No KPI set, no cadence, no dashboard. — —
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — City real-estate holdings do not appear. Empty-lot housing conversion is context on row 2, not a Hall real-estate programme. — —
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — Procurement, open data, Wi-Fi and EV charging do not appear. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic **Close 2.0** "Ensure Crystal Pool is built to energy standards to lower the city's carbon emission." · Commits × Comparable: a municipal building-energy climate instrument, not the Climate Leadership Plan 50%/2030 set, not district energy, not seismic. Ambiguity up from Partial+: energy standards is an instrument, not a target with none. FLAG: one capital project, not a citywide climate programme. Context, same block, not scored separately: "High penalties for companies who do not effectively dispose of building materials and other waste properly." [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness — No 5,000-tree target, no canopy number, no emergency-preparedness position. Mode share / bike lanes sit inside the sentence already scored on row 27. One sentence, one measure. Building-waste penalties are context on row 48. — —
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule — Crystal Pool referendum is past advocacy (Let’s Get Crystal Clear), not a \$25M threshold, a 5-step sequence, or a material-change rule. Championing that referendum is not a 2026 process rule. — —
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response — No Integrity Commissioner, no 60-day consultation-response standard, no code-of-conduct instrument. — —
52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration — No lobbyist registry, no FOI-fee position, no remuneration rule. — —
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans **Close 2.0** "Invest in community centres for Jubilee, and James Bay." · Commits × Comparable: named-neighbourhood facilities, not a neighbourhood-grant line, not language access, not Local Area Plans. Context, same Thriving Communities block, not scored separately: "A new library in Quadra village" and "Ensure community associations have the tools they need" (the latter is Mentions without the grant instrument). [https://www.bellalee.ca/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod 1 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access — No survey instrument, no advance-vote or ballot-access position. The living-document preface about talking to people is not M82. — —
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — Amalgamation does not appear. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [campaign home](https://www.bellalee.ca/) (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [about](https://www.bellalee.ca/about) · [/policy](https://www.bellalee.ca/policy) lastmod **1 Jul 2026 16:40 PT** (Squarespace `updatedOn` 1782949202557) · [get-involved](https://www.bellalee.ca/get-involved) (volunteer form only) · [Victoria News launch, 30 Mar 2026](https://vicnews.com/2026/03/30/bella-lee-launches-bid-for-council-to-build-a-better-victoria/) (not used for a cell; /policy is stronger) · [Victoria Buzz joint piece, 30 Jun 2026](https://victoriabuzz.com/2026/06/duo-of-young-candidates-running-for-victoria-city-council-with-focus-on-housing/) (Colwood clinic and more-affordable-housing corroborate /policy; reporter summary of shared climate/safety ideas is not her sentence) · VoteMate Victoria riding list retrieved 2026-09-02: **no Bella Lee profile, no questionnaire** · ACTW live profile [https://acitythatworks.ca/profiles/lee](https://acitythatworks.ca/profiles/lee) (1 Sep vintage said no detailed platform; /policy exists and is used here). - **Not a source, applied:** MCFD senior-adviser role and family-policy domain (banned inference; no M12 childcare-spaces sentence) · Greater Victoria Placemaking Network, Capital Bikes, Chinatown Lionesses, Girl Guides, Our Place · 2018 Oak Bay run, 2022 Alto campaign manager, Victoria and Esquimalt Police Board seat · joint door-knocking with Jack Sandor (his sentences are not hers) · third-party endorsement (none confirmed; Labour Council not inferred). - **Past advocacy excluded (not 2026 municipal promises):** CRD homelessness-share campaign · Access BC free contraception · Let’s Get Crystal Clear pool referendum. - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** Fourteen sentences carry the fourteen scored cells: (1) 3- and 4-bedroom / homes for families → row 1. (2) purpose-built co-ops → row 2. (3) storefront vacancy tax → row 18. (4) City-done repairs + 25% service tax / pets in rentals → row 21. (5) housing liaison out of transitional housing → row 23. (6) doctor/NP housing + city-owned walk-in clinic → row 24. (7) DVBA graffiti removal and facade repairs → row 26. (8) bike-lane improvements and inter-municipal connections → row 27. (9) fare-free seniors / bus shelters / lower bus fees → row 28. (10) Demand a Regional Police Force → row 33. (11) parks BBQs and pavilions → row 38. (12) CRD Rec pass → row 39. (13) Crystal Pool energy standards → row 48. (14) community centres for Jubilee and James Bay → row 53. - **Contested allocations.** Row 33 Close 2.0 not Aligned: 1 Sep pack is convene-and-publish, no binding other force. Row 21 Close not Partial: tenant-protection half of M9, ambiguity up. Row 26 Close: graffiti via DVBA is a different sentence from the vacancy tax; scoring both is one-sentence-one-measure, not a double mark on one downtown block. Row 38 Close: parks infrastructure vs heritage incentives/lighting. Row 39 Close: rec pass vs funding floor; CRD-wide delivery is a feasibility FLAG, not a haircut. Row 48 Close: one capital-project energy standard vs CLP/district energy/seismic; ambiguity up from Partial+. Row 53 Close: named neighbourhood facilities vs grants/LAPs. Row 10 left Mentions, not Opposed. - **Not scored, on purpose.** Theft special unit — not M26, not M28 data-targeting, not M28b cost-spreading. Harm reduction / safe supply — not M33b, not Opposed. Rock Bay revitalization — not mapped to M45c. Arts "continue to invest" — Mentions. Road construction "makes sense" — Mentions. Host Nations acknowledgement — not M1–M5. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence:** none. No City office held 2022–26. Challenger: no Record haircut. - **Legal-feasibility FLAG, not a scoring haircut.** CRD Rec pass, outdoor regional pool, regional police force, and bail reform sit outside what a single councillor can deliver unilaterally. Face-test still scores the published 2026 sentences; capacity is noted, not used to mark Opposed or to invent a dash. - **Never-list:** no Lisnard / Estrosi / Knafo / Musk / Brivael / Poilievre language used as a source or analogy. - **Social:** not used. Instruction was not to touch social. Cells rest on /policy + dated news only where /policy already carries the sentence. - **Rows to put to the candidate before publication:** row 33 (convene-and-publish vs a binding regional force) · row 13 (any residential-rate path) · row 10 (keep, repeal, or replace 7 a.m. tent-removal) · M12 childcare spaces · M70b provincial-downloading ledger (live profile noted this as the still-worth-naming gap) · M33b buffer vs harm-reduction/safe-supply. - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close **11 Sep 2026**, and if /policy is finalised ("living document… before the writ drops in September"). - M83 (civic access / public correction, \$0) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. ## INTERNAL proposed letter — not the live letter **PROPOSE: B** · n = 14 · mean 2.00 Close 2.0 ×14 (rows 1, 2, 18, 21, 23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 33, 38, 39, 48, 53). No Partial, no Opposed, no Aligned. Sum: **28.0** across **14** scored cells. Mean **2.00**, band **B** (2.00–2.24), which maps to **B** on the live set (B+, B, C, D, —). A/A−→B+, B−→B, C+/C−→C, F→D does not move this one. **This is a proposal, not the live letter.** The card above shows **—**. The live letter waits for Joa's click and compute must not overwrite it. Alignment compute APPLIED for Lee stays **B** unless Joa clicks. **What the proposal is measuring.** Fourteen Close cells, no disagreements. The mean is B because every scored instrument is comparable rather than the same, and because forty-one dashes are excluded from the denominator. **Fragility.** Drop M58 and M50 (the two most contestable Closes) and the mean is still 2.00 on 12 cells. Restore M29 to Aligned 3.0 and the mean is 2.07, still B. Drop M9/M14/M38/M39/M48/M53 back to the thinner 9-cell set with one Partial and the mean is 1.89 (B− → B). The letter is B on every reasonable subset. Forty-one dashes. Re-score when /policy is no longer a living document.
